# ArXiv MCP

> ArXiv preprint search, paper metadata, daily category digest, author collaboration graph

This MCP server exposes 4 tools via the Model Context Protocol (JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP POST). It runs on Cloudflare Workers and is billed via Dodo Payments. Authenticated via `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` obtained by subscribing at `https://arxiv-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/upgrade`.

## Endpoint
- MCP JSON-RPC: https://arxiv-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/mcp
- Health: https://arxiv-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/health
- Landing page: https://arxiv-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/
- Get API key: https://arxiv-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/upgrade?tier=solo

## Tools
- `arxiv_search`: Search arXiv by free-text, author, and/or category. Up to 100 results.
- `arxiv_get_paper`: Paper metadata + abstract by id (e.g. '2024.04567' or 'arXiv:2024.04567v2').
- `arxiv_daily_digest`: Recently-submitted papers in a category — daily catch-up.
- `arxiv_author_graph`: Build a collaborator graph rooted at an author (depth 1 = direct co-authors).

## Authentication
Pass `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` on POST /mcp. Free tier: anonymous, 100 calls / month / IP.

## Pricing
- Free: 100 calls / month (anonymous, no signup)
- Solo $9/mo: 2,000 calls / month, 60/min
- Team $29/mo: 10,000 calls / month, 200/min, 5 team seats
- Pro $79/mo: 50,000 calls / month, 600/min, 25 team seats
Billed via Dodo Payments (merchant-of-record). Cancel anytime.

## Account management
- View account: GET https://arxiv-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/account (Bearer)
- Rotate key: POST https://arxiv-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/account/rotate (Bearer)
- GDPR data export: GET https://arxiv-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/account/export (Bearer)
- Team management (Team+): https://arxiv-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/account/team
